author: kedhareswer
name: Meeting Booking Calendar
description: Meeting booking calendar: a book-a-call section that does the booking itself. A bold headline over a scheduler window with the host's card, call lengths and a timezone-aware week of open slots. Pick a slot and it grows into a confirm form; confirm and it flips into a perforated ticket stamped booked, with an .ics download. A Check against my calendar switch hatches your busy blocks and strikes clashing slots. Fully customisable host, hours, slots and colours.
